We are continuing to introduce more fixes to remove outstanding issues from your experience. Today we are back with another patch, first of all addressing A key problem.

Today we resolved the keyboard issue for the two next languages you have reported to be suffering from. After the update, all players using their native Ukrainian and Finnish keyboard layouts will be able to use the A button without the need to bind it to a different diacritic symbol.

notes.title: Offroad Mechanic Simulator Update 1.03
notes.content:
Hi, offroad maniacs!

We hope that you've got your fair share of fun with offroading in our game already. Nevertheless, some of you still experienced some specific issues, that we are addressing in this patch. Thank you for your bug reporting and willingness to help us in reproducing them!

In today's patch, we are introducing a requested quality-of-life change. The need for constantly closing the F1 tips was bothering some players, so we have added an option to automatically switch them off. This way you can choose to not display them when they're no longer needed.

In addition, we have removed the spare wheel holder showing as a "ghost part", mostly appearing when driving Yeep Rancher. We have also amended an issue with camera zoom during working on Pickup 1500 and a minor Mishubi Palermo screw misplacement. We have also found some instances of the winch prompt on Desert that still weren't changed to not informing about attaching the part to a tree, so we have extended our fix to include them.

[quote]Please note: we are still working on the issue of parts being missing from the assembly mode selection menu, but still being present in storage. It is particularly hard to reproduce in a testing environment, so it may take us more time - thank you for sending us saves and logs to help us to find the source of the issue. The issue is resolved by reloading the save, so please use this solution until we provide a fix.[/quote]

notes.title: DEVLOG - APRIL EDITION
notes.content:
Hi, offroad enthusiasts!

We're sure that by this point you gave our free prologue for Offroad Mechanic Simulator more than one spin. Thank you for all the positive reactions and thoughtful feedback! However, the time is nigh to show you some more attractions that will be available for you in the full version of the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2260130/Offroad_Mechanic_Simulator_Prologue__First_Job/

[h2]The desert and the night races[/h2]

In the prologue, you had an occasion to drive through a large part of our Forest map. But, as all offroad fans know, there are other places that can provide the right challenge. Some are much, much arider. That's right, we are talking about our second map, the Desert. This rocky and sandy landscape nearly without plant life (but above the average number of animal skulls and skeletons) is definitely hard to traverse. It also provides different problems to solve with the right car modifications and tools at your disposal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/9aec35f84e095dd3adf67327262507b90f3122c9.gif[/img]

And you will have to solve them because the terrain is extremely uneven. This is not your Sahara, this is more like a rocky desertscape of Arizona or Nevada. Some races will have you fighting time while climbing steep terrace formations, while others will take you through needle eyes between massive hoodoos. Some specific gadgets, like rock anchors for your winch, will be elemental to brave the most complicated parts of this rock climb.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/d4bd5d4960389150b94848cc7acd15306d4e6c45.gif[/img]

Need more challenge than that? Try to navigate this rocky maze at night. Yes, our time-sensitive races will have their nightly versions. Visibility will become essential for you - because if you don't see the next obstacle, you will probably fail to overcome it! Nighttime races will be available across all maps, and you will have the parts to modify your cars for these dark conditions. Roof-mounted lighting options are available in our in-game shop and they will be your best friends for this kind of task.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/0706c27ad78d88dba46fbb26acd874ac70edea28.gif[/img]

Of course, please remember that above sneak peeks are work in progress, from a pre-release build - we're still updating the game with new elements and tweaking everything.

[hr][/hr]
Remember that you can ask us anything on Discord:

[url=https://discord.gg/q3AEaFyXX2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/2fc705973d339be579fc7a40a2b877dc85c1fdfb.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1387500/Offroad_Mechanic_Simulator/

notes.title: DEVLOG - JANUARY EDITION
notes.content:
Greetings, future offroad mechanics!

As you remember, at the end of December we announced Offroad Mechanic Simulator: Prologue - First Job, a free version of the game coming to Steam soon. But you might not know that this Prologue will show off a lot of changes made to the game between the time of the demo/other presentations and today. Offroad Mechanic Simulator is evolving fast and taking its final shape - also thanks to Your invaluable feedback!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2260130/Offroad_Mechanic_Simulator_Prologue__First_Job/

[h2][b]The new UI[/b][/h2]

In the Prologue, you will have access to a much larger part of the game, where you will find many new features - and also improvements bigger and smaller. But the most important changes for many of the demo players come directly from their feedback. Those technical improvements will make the gameplay feel new and better suited to your needs, and give you an idea of how the full product will play. Along with major updates to physics and handling, we have changed the entire UI for your driving pleasure!

Below you will find a clip from a test drive, which shows off modernized and streamlined UI in action (please be informed that the presented car will only be available in full version):

[previewyoutube=HNgJxj3CV8I;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you again for your feedback on this matter! All of these changes address issues and ideas provided by our players!

[h2][b]Prologue cars[/b][/h2]

We have also added updated screenshots to the Offroad Mechanic Simulator: Prologue - First Job card on Steam. Thanks to those, you can take a peek at the cars that will be available. Below you will find a selection of those screenshots - there are some beauties in this garage, as you can see!

notes.title: DEVLOG - December edition
notes.content:
Greetings offroad enthusiasts!

Time to show you some of the latest changes in [b]Offroad Mechanic Simulator[/b]! There are three main features that this devlog will address. Of course, a lot more happened behind the scenes since we released our demo. We will share more information in future devlogs - or, if there's anything specific you want to know about, let us know in the comments!

[h3]Let's start with [b]the garage[/b]![/h3]
This is the hub for every player. It's divided into a few separate areas:
[list]
[*] Workshop - this is where the magic happens and where you will spend most of your time. You start with room for just 1 car. However, once you unlock additional areas in the workshop, you will be able to fix and upgrade up to 3 different cars at the same time!
[*] Garage - you need a place to store your cars and that's where it is. You start with just two slots but as you make progress, you will gradually unlock 6 more.
[*] Storage - as the name suggests, this is where you can find car parts that you own
[*] Car wash - it's not unusual for a car to return dirty from an offroad adventure. This is where you can remove dirt from any angle, to prevent any car parts from corroding.
[*] Chip tuning - are you in need of some additional horsepower? Then that's where you need to go!
[/list]
Transferring cars between stations is very simple and can be done with just a few clicks:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/02ba2ebd03296b0e1b0eb3d68052a7e0c9b16d52.gif[/img]

[h3]Next, let's discuss the [b]car wash[/b]![/h3]
Nobody likes a dirty car. Thing is, in your job of servicing offroad vehicles, practically every car you get your hands on is going to be covered in mud. This isn't just a problem because of the aesthetics. Dirty parts can corrode and degrade in quality over time. So always remember to clean your car if you take it to a windy desert canyon or force it through a muddy river!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/19c8c7dc359f405cb0265cd2adb619da8b023173.gif[/img]

[h3]Finally, it's time to talk about [b]chip tuning[/b]![/h3]
This is a new feature that will let you squeeze out that little bit of extra power from your engines. To start tweaking the settings, you must move a car to a separate room in your garage, where you have the equipment necessary for chip tuning. Once everything is in place, you must use a nearby laptop and tinker with the engine by completing a simple minigame. As with everything else, this feature is based on things you do in real life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/b06bea6a266e8f1ca5cf87ca427a475e193b3e28.gif[/img]

Of course, all of the above GIFs are not final, we are still tweaking the visual of this game and everything is subject to change. That being said, what are your thoughts on this devlog? Let us know on[url=https://discord.gg/6HQNet6Hm8] our official Discord server[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1387500/Offroad_Mechanic_Simulator/

notes.title: Offroad Mechanic Simulator - Devlog III
notes.content:
Hello offroad enthusiasts!

You probably wonder what’s going on in the Offroad Mechanic Simulator? We know it has been a while since the last devlog so we prepared a fresh batch of in-development information! You can read about it below but also check our devlog video:

[previewyoutube=ZYJgaiJx33g;full][/previewyoutube]

The first thing we’d like to share with you is the in-game store. It has been hugely updated to make it more user-friendly. When you enter the store you now have a choice between basic parts, additional parts, and off-road accessories, Everything here is now heavily re-designed, allowing you to sort items by categories and filter them by particular car models. Whenever you add an item to your shopping basket a piece of information is being displayed telling you which cars it can be mounted on. After the purchase additional window pops up to confirm the sale and inform you where exactly the part is now stocked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/e6775ac3c3e88f6cc759a3d2e4361472dc7e0972.gif[/img]

We also finished the final iteration of suspension for one of our off-road cars. It now includes all the elements that make up its real-life counterpart. We didn’t skip a single one! All the rods, sleeves, steering knuckles are now included. Another new feature we created is the inventory of each car which is now accessible through its rear door enabling easy access to any equipped items such as a high lift for example. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/5de195bd8aeddf67eb727d3dcf14a88ffc644db6.gif[/img]

Forest map, while far from being ready and done, now looks a lot better than in previous game builds with much more dense foliage and better lighting. Along with it, we are already testing the tasks system. As for now, it is represented by very simple panels since we are focusing on the functionality not the looks at this stage of development. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/2c10f581e2ed7728ee856877bc82e3509d1ca9c8.gif[/img]

Task system leads us to another new feature we implemented. Now we can:

[list]
[*] already damage the car while driving in the wilderness
[*] perform suspension diagnostics in your garage
[/list]
We are developing two ways of determining car damage in the Offroad Mechanic Simulator. The visual system is still under development but the ability to run computer diagnostics is already working. You are now able to inspect the suspension and check the exact condition of any part.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/330ae549b73c5a29af4f8fa391ae493f0c33f11d.gif[/img]

That’s all we prepared for you in this devlog. We are constantly moving forward, developing and improving the game and we still have months of work ahead of us. If you have any questions about Offroad Mechanic Simulator, feel free to ask them on our official Discord server: [b]https://discord.gg/3xTsvcw3QB [/b]

Cheers! 
Image Power and Gameformatic teams!

notes.title: Offroad Mechanic Simulator - Devlog II
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, offroad enthusiasts![/h2]

It's about time [b]Offroad Mechanic Simulator[/b] gets another devlog! Are you ready for another round of insider information, straight from the production line? Then get ready and take a look at the progress we've made!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/25c1c2b28697a658ec627909fe289d1aa9b6f471.gif[/img]

[b]Equipment [/b]and[b] inventory management [/b]was the name of the game for us these past few weeks. In Offroad Mechanic Simulator, you deal with inventory not only in your own garage but also out in the wilderness, when you're off on one of our test tracks!

Let's start with what you can mount on your cars. As mentioned in the last devlog, you use a computer to order new parts. After you pay for them, they are available in your garage inventory, meaning that you can walk up to any car and attach new items to it. You can do so via a new, handy menu, which lets you choose the [b]location [/b]and [b]type [/b]of part you want to install on your vehicle. It's super convenient!

Separately from all this, there is also another inventory that you have access to while driving. During a test ride, you can get out of your car and access said inventory by interacting with the trunk. This lets you access a variety of items that can help you get out from a tight spot. With their help, you can lift your car or attach it to a tree so that you can pull yourself out of some thick mud.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/ba9e3d9832bb783fa8a93f13646e1670b2b97bb4.gif[/img]

Other than that, the game had numerous quality of life improvements. For example, graphics and audio options have been implemented, as well as new camera options. While driving, the player has a number of new settings, that allow them to choose the perspective they want. There are a few different ones to choose from, such as an overhead camera or a zoom on one of your front wheels.

We also implemented a [b]dependency system[/b]. This system prevents the player from tampering with parts that are blocked by other car elements. When a player selects a segment that is blocked, the game will highlight all parts that are connected to it. This will be very convenient when you need to repair a specific element that is buried somewhere deep in the hydraulics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/f44c161a9c018f24a7419cac07f5fb6fef5580d9.gif[/img]

That's everything for this particular devlog. We are moving forward at a steady pace and can't wait to bring you this exciting, new game. If you have any questions about Offroad Mechanic Simulator, feel free to ask them on our official Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/wnX4tvhASg]https://discord.gg/wnX4tvhASg[/url]

Best regards,
Image Power team
